properties.site-address: Former Builders Yard and Office, Union Street, Blyth
properties.notes: Vacant land and buildings previously used for employment purposes, being occupied by a builders yard. A previous planning permission for 23 homes lapsed without being started (B/09/00008/FUL). The site is likely to represent a longer-term option for development. High density and yield is fitting for location, reflecting proposals for flats/apartments.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
